name: Temporary Stay Visa for Family Accompaniment (Visto de Permanência Temporária)

requirements.blocker_text: Per Angola's own consulate in Lisbon, the Visto de Permanência Temporária explicitly covers spouses of Angolan citizens as a qualifying category, alongside family members of valid residency-authorization holders and family members accompanying holders of study, medical-treatment, investor, or work visas. The visa must be used within 60 days of issuance, permits stays of up to 365 days (renewable until the underlying sponsoring reason concludes), and allows multiple entries.
requirements.fix_path: Apply at an Angolan consulate as the spouse of an Angolan citizen, submitting the marriage certificate and standard supporting documents.

requirement_groups.name: Family member of a residency-authorization or sponsoring-visa holder

requirements.blocker_text: The same Visto de Permanência Temporária category also covers family members accompanying a holder of a study, medical-treatment, investor, or work visa, and family members of anyone holding a valid Angolan residency authorization -- confirmed directly on the same official consular page as the spouse-of-citizen route above.
requirements.fix_path: Apply at an Angolan consulate as a qualifying family member of a residency-authorization holder or of a study/medical/investor/work visa holder.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate (spouse route) or proof of family relationship
Sponsor's Angolan citizenship or residency/visa documentation

outcome.duration_length: up to 365 days, renewable until the sponsoring reason concludes

sources.title: Consulado Geral da República de Angola em Lisboa (official Angolan government consulate) -- Visto de Permanência Temporária eligibility categories including spouse-of-citizen and family-accompaniment provisions, validity, and process

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Angola). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- read directly from Angola's own consulate (a genuine government source, tier 1), confirming both qualifying groups explicitly rather than inferring them. citizenship_after_months (60) reflects the reduced 5-year marriage-based naturalization track under Lei 2/16 Article 13 (see ao_citizenship_naturalisation.json) for the spouse-of-citizen group specifically -- the family-of-resident group has no comparably fast citizenship path and would instead follow the standard 10-year naturalization track; this dataset models the faster of the two group-level outcomes at the file level for simplicity, with the distinction documented here rather than silently averaged. dual_citizenship_allowed set to false per Article 32 of the Nationality Law, which applies uniformly regardless of the route taken to citizenship.
